# Verdict Watch
> The invalidation primitive for verified claims — re-checks the evidence behind signed trust claims and reports drift for human review.

Re-verification engine for signed trust claims: registers watches on claim envelopes, re-checks evidence (http-hash / oEmbed / HF-dataset strategies), and emits STILL_VALID / BASELINED / CHANGED / DEAD / UNREACHABLE findings.

## Live
- App: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-watch/
- Try it: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-watch/

## Features
- 3 re-check strategies (http-hash, oembed, hf-dataset)
- Machine-readable findings (cwi.watch-finding/1.0)
- ?watch=<envelope-url> deep links
- Dogfood: CWI's own 8 trust-log envelopes
- 40/40 tests

## Machine-readable
- watches: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-watch/watches.json
- schema: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-watch/schema/findings.schema.json

## Honest limits
v1 flags drift for human review — it NEVER auto-downgrades a claim. Browser checks are best-effort (CORS-blocked URLs report UNREACHABLE, never DEAD).

## Provider
Cumulative Web Inc — hp@cumulativeweb.com
